runs.emptyBody: Your production runs will be here: what you make, from which recipe, and the lots each run produces.
runs.title: Run {{code}}
runs.loadFailed: This production run couldn't be loaded.
runs.saveFailed: The production run couldn't be saved.
runs.deleteFailed: The production run couldn't be deleted.
runs.deleteBody: The run and its lines are deleted. It hasn't moved any stock.
runs.codeHint: Also the number of the lot it makes. Left blank, the next free code.
runs.uncostedBody: Something it consumed had no cost on the day it was completed, usually because it was out of stock. Record the purchase or stock it came from, dated on or before that day, and the run's cost follows.
runs.completeBody: Completing it takes each line out of stock, from its lot or the one Hoard assumes, and puts what was made into lot {{code}}.
runs.reopenBody: What it consumed goes back into stock and lot {{code}} is removed. Lots Hoard assumed are assumed again when it is completed.

errors.RUN_NO_RECIPE: That has no recipe to make it from. Add one first.
errors.RUN_COMPLETED: The run is completed. Reopen it to change what it used.
errors.RUN_LOT_MISMATCH: That lot isn't one of this item at the run's location.
errors.LOT_IN_USE: Something else has drawn on the lot this run made, so it can't be reopened.
